parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Ulakwo (Etche LGA survey stations). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 14.369 | 0.124 | 0.12415
2 | 15.965 | 8.25 | 9.665
3 | 4591.4 | 27.074 | 47.738
4 | 5101.5 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as A-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Ulakwo
Curve type: A-type
Aquifer depth: 9.67 m – 47.74 m (with a deeper, thicker resistive unit continuing below 47.74 m)
Recommendation: Case and seal off the low-resistivity near-surface materials (0–9.67 m) to prevent contamination, then screen the borehole within the high-resistivity sand/gravel sequence from about 9.67 m to 47.74 m (and continue drilling into the underlying resistive layer below 47.74 m if greater yield is required), confirming lithology with cuttings as drilling proceeds.
